The last stone in a horizontal course, if smaller than the others; a piece of brick finishing a course.

quotes.text: The longitudinal bond of the walls is only 24 inches, or one fourth of the length of a brick of 9 inches, and is obtained by introducing closers 24 inches broad

senses.definition: (baseball) A relief pitcher who specializes in getting the last three outs of the game.
examples: They brought their closer in for the ninth.

senses.definition: (horse racing) A horse that performs best toward the end of a race.
